newsitem.title: JAPAN: DDI SHARES TUMBLE ON WANING PHS DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: DDI SHARES TUMBLE ON WANING PHS DEMAND.

text.p: Shares of domestic long-distance telecommunications company DDI Corp tumbled on Friday afternoon, dragged down by data showing that fewer people are subscribing to the personal handyphone system (PHS), traders said.
A unit of DDI is involved in the PHS business.
DDI's share price briefly hit a limit low of 677,000 yen, a new low for this calendar year. It was ask-only throughout the morning session.
At 0508 GMT, DDI's share price was down 95,000 yen or 12.23 percent at 682,000 yen, making the issue the fourth largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
